column1: # The prebuilt todo binary shipped with the todo skill.
# Built per target by CI and by ../setup-dev-env.sh; never committed.
# Rust rather than shell so the queue's tools need no shell at all: they behave
# the same under bash, zsh or anything else, and survive macOS retiring the bash
# it ships. A static binary also asks the target machine for nothing, which is
# why this skill's requires.tsv declares no tools.
# A SEPARATE binary from bug-report's `bugs`, not a mode of it: the two registers
# do not share their rules, and one shared implementation had to pretend they
# did. See src/todo/src/register.rs for what differs.
